cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: We've discussed a brief overview of an anatomy of what a neural network is.
cues.zh: 我們簡單討論過神經網路的組成概況。

cues.en: But let's now discuss some learning paradigms.
cues.zh: 現在討論一些學習典範。

cues.en: So the first one is supervised learning.
cues.zh: 第一種是監督式學習，

cues.en: And then we have unsupervised and self supervised learning and transfer learning.
cues.zh: 接著有非監督式、自監督式學習，以及遷移學習。

cues.en: Now, supervised learning is when you have data and labels such as in the example we gave at the start,
cues.zh: 監督式學習，是有資料與標籤的情況，就像開頭的例子，

cues.en: which was how you would build a neural network or a machine learning algorithm to figure out the rules to cook your Sicilian grandmother's famous roast chicken dish.
cues.zh: 如何建立神經網路或機器學習演算法，找出烹調西西里奶奶拿手烤雞的規則。

cues.en: So in the case of supervised learning, you'd have a lot of data.
cues.zh: 監督式學習裡，會有大量資料，

cues.en: So inputs such as raw ingredients as vegetables and chicken, and a lot of examples of what that inputs should ideally look like.
cues.zh: 輸入像是蔬菜與雞等生食材，以及許多例子，顯示這些輸入理想上應該變成什麼。

cues.en: Or in the case of discerning photos between a cat and a dog.
cues.zh: 或者是分辨貓與狗的照片，

cues.en: You might have a thousand photos of a cat and a thousand photos of a dog that you know which photos are cat and which photos are dog.
cues.zh: 可能有一千張貓、一千張狗的照片，而且知道哪些照片是貓，哪些是狗。

cues.en: And you pass those photos to a machine learning algorithm to discern.
cues.zh: 把這些照片傳給機器學習演算法來分辨。

cues.en: So in that case, you have data, the photos and the labels, a.k.a. cat and dog for each of those photos.
cues.zh: 這時有資料，也就是照片，也有每張照片的標籤，也就是貓與狗。

cues.en: So that's supervised learning data and labels.
cues.zh: 這就是監督式學習，有資料與標籤。

cues.en: Unsupervised and Self-supervised learning is you just have the data itself.
cues.zh: 非監督式與自監督式學習，則只有資料本身，

cues.en: You don't have any labels.
cues.zh: 沒有任何標籤。

cues.en: So in the case of cat and dog photos, you only have the photos.
cues.zh: 在貓狗照片的例子裡，就只有照片，

cues.en: You don't have the labels of cat and dog.
cues.zh: 沒有貓、狗標籤。

cues.en: So in the case of Self-supervised learning, you could get a machine learning algorithm to learn an inherent representation of what?
cues.zh: 自監督式學習可以讓機器學習演算法，學到某種內在表示。

cues.en: And when I say representation, I mean patterns in numbers.
cues.zh: 我說表示，是指數字裡的模式，

cues.en: I mean weights.
cues.zh: 是指權重，

cues.en: I mean features, a whole bunch of different names describing the same thing.
cues.zh: 是指特徵，用很多不同名稱描述相同的事情。

cues.en: You could get a self-supervised learning algorithm to figure out the fundamental patterns between a
cues.zh: 可以讓自監督式學習演算法，找出狗

cues.en: dog and a cat image, but it wouldn't necessarily know the difference between the two.
cues.zh: 與貓影像裡的基本模式，但它不一定知道兩者的差別。

cues.en: That's where you could come in later and go, Show me the patterns you've learned and it might show you the patterns and you can go, okay, The patterns that look like this are dog and the patterns that look like that.
cues.zh: 之後就能由你介入，說：「讓我看看你學到的模式。」它可能會顯示模式，你就能說，像這種模式的是狗，像那種模式的，

cues.en: A cat.
cues.zh: 是貓。

cues.en: So self-supervised and unsupervised learning learn solely on the data itself.
cues.zh: 所以自監督式與非監督式學習，都只從資料本身學習。

cues.en: And then finally, transfer learning is a very, very important paradigm in deep learning.
cues.zh: 最後，遷移學習是深度學習非常重要的一種典範，

cues.en: It's taking the patterns that one model has learned of a data set and transferring it to another model,
cues.zh: 把一個模型從某個資料集學到的模式，轉移到另一個模型。

cues.en: such in the case of if we were trying to build a supervised learning algorithm for discerning between
cues.zh: 例如要建立監督式學習演算法，分辨

cues.en: cat and dog photos, we might start with a model that has already learned patterns and images and transfer those foundational patterns to our own model so that our model gets a head start.
cues.zh: 貓狗照片，可以從已經學會影像模式的模型開始，把那些基礎模式轉到自己的模型，讓它先有個好的起點。

cues.en: This is transfer.
cues.zh: 這就是遷移

cues.en: Learning is a very, very powerful technique.
cues.zh: 學習，是非常強大的技巧。

cues.en: But as for this course, we're going to be writing code to focus on these two supervised learning and transfer learning, which are two of the most common paradigms or common types of learning and machine
cues.zh: 這門課會著重寫程式完成這兩種：監督式學習與遷移學習，它們是機器

cues.en: learning and deep learning.
cues.zh: 學習與深度學習裡最常見的兩種典範、學習類型。

cues.en: However, this style of code, though, can be adapted across different learning paradigms.
cues.zh: 不過，這種風格的程式碼，也能調整成不同的學習典範。

cues.en: Now I just want to let you know there is one that I haven't mentioned here, which is kind of in its own bucket, and that is reinforcement learning.
cues.zh: 我想讓你知道，這裡還有一種沒提到，有點自成一類的學習，就是強化學習。

cues.en: So I'll leave this as an extension if you wanted to look it up.
cues.zh: 如果有興趣查，可以把它當作延伸內容。

cues.en: But essentially this is a good one.
cues.zh: 基本上，這個不錯，

cues.en: It's a good photo actually.
cues.zh: 這張圖其實很好，

cues.en: So shout out to Katie Nuggets.
cues.zh: 感謝 KDnuggets。

cues.en: The whole idea of reinforcement learning is that you have some kind of environment and an agent that does actions in that environment and you give rewards and observations back to that agent.
cues.zh: 強化學習的整體概念，是有某種環境，以及在環境裡執行動作的代理，再把獎勵與觀測回饋給代理。

cues.en: So say for example, you wanted to teach your dog to urinate outside.
cues.zh: 例如，想教狗到外面尿尿，

cues.en: Well, you would reward its actions of urinating outside and possibly not reward its actions of urinating all over your couch.
cues.zh: 就獎勵牠在外面尿尿的行為，也許不獎勵牠在沙發上到處尿尿的行為。

cues.en: So reinforcement learning is again, it's kind of in its own paradigm.
cues.zh: 所以強化學習有點自成一種典範。

cues.en: This picture has a good explanation between unsupervised learning, supervised learning to separate two different things, and then reinforcement learning is kind of like that.
cues.zh: 這張圖很好地解釋了非監督式、監督式學習：區分兩種不同東西；而強化學習則像這樣。

cues.en: But again, I will let you research the different learning paradigms a little bit more in your own time.
cues.zh: 不過，還是留給你自己花時間，再多研究不同的學習典範。

cues.en: As I said, we're going to be focused on writing code to do supervised learning and transfer learning, specifically PyTorch code.
cues.zh: 如同剛才說的，我們會著重寫程式，進行監督式與遷移學習，具體使用 PyTorch 程式碼。

cues.en: Now with that covered, let's get a few examples of what is deep learning actually used for.
cues.zh: 介紹完這些，看看深度學習究竟用在哪些地方。

cues.en: And before we get into the next video, I'm going to issue you a challenge to search this question yourself and come up with some of your own ideas for what deep learning is currently used for.
cues.zh: 進入下支影片之前，給你一個挑戰：自己搜尋這個問題，想出幾個目前深度學習用途的想法。

cues.en: So give that a shot and I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 試試看，下支影片見。
